about: Phase D of documentation/engineering/agentic-ai-next-plan.md: CarePath incidents and changes, written as a ServiceNow import would store them, each open incident labelled with the record that is its cause. DEMONSTRATION ARTIFACT - synthetic content only, grounded in documentation/demo/docs/06-operate (the operations runbook OPS-CAREPATH-002 and the INC-2026-0814 postmortem). Loaded once into an application by `manage.py triage_pack <app> --as <user> --load-incidents`; scored by `triage_pack ... --labelled`. A new pack starts a new reference: do not edit casually.

records.title: Patient search exhausted the database connection

fields.Close notes: GET /patients passed its limit to the database unbounded. A single-letter family name prefix with limit=100000 read the whole patient table and held a transaction past the 2s ceiling, which blocked every write behind it on the single SQLite writer. Restarted carepath-api-blue to clear the held transactions. Follow-up A-1: clamp limit on GET /patients to the maximum page size, as encounters, referrals and consent already do.

records.text: For 45 minutes roughly 60% of requests returned 5xx and two clinics could not open patient records. The p95 latency alert fired at 14:03, three minutes before the error rate crossed 1%. Ingress logs showed three long-running GET /patients requests from one coordinator browsing the cohort.

records.title: Patient records failing to open, 5xx rising
records.text: Since about 10:00 around half of requests fail with 5xx and the ward reports that patient records will not open. The p95 latency alert fired at 09:58. Ingress shows several long-running GET /patients requests from the cohort report job.

records.title: Allow larger patient search pages for the cohort report
records.text: Raises the limit GET /patients accepts to 50,000 so the nightly cohort report can read the patient list in one page. The page-size clamp added after INC-2026-0814 (action A-1) is removed for this endpoint only.

records.title: Renew the TLS certificate on the CarePath ingress
records.text: Replaces the certificate for carepath.riverside.example before it expires. No application change.

records.title: Readiness failing while liveness still answers
records.text: /health/ready has returned 503 since about 22:10 while /health/live still answers, so the process is up and the database is not. Writes fail with 'database or disk is full'. The orchestrator has not restarted the instances.

records.title: Keep 30 daily snapshots on the carepath-data volume
records.text: Raises snapshot retention on the carepath-data volume from 7 daily snapshots to 30, for the restore rehearsal. The snapshots are kept on the same volume as the database.

records.title: Move the nightly snapshot from 02:00 to 22:00
records.text: Takes the nightly snapshot of carepath-data at 22:00 instead of 02:00, outside the overnight batch window.

records.title: Audit write failed on patient record reads
records.text: Reads of patient records return 500. Every request that should write an audit event logs 'permission denied for table audit_event'. The service has been taken out of the pool, as the runbook requires when an audit write fails, and Information Governance has been told.

records.title: Restrict the CarePath database role to the tables it uses
records.text: Revokes every privilege the application role does not need. The role keeps SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE on patient, encounter, referral, consent and consent_history; everything else is revoked.

records.title: Rotate the partner API tokens for the quarter
records.text: The 90-day rotation from ADR-0002: new token digests added in a first deployment and the old ones removed in a second, as the runbook says.

records.title: Partner exports refused with 401
records.text: Riverside Health's export client has received 401 for every request since about 09:00. They have not been given a new token since last quarter. Other API callers are unaffected.

records.title: Finish the partner token rotation in one deployment
records.text: Adds the new partner token digests and removes the old ones in the same deployment, to complete this quarter's rotation in a single change.

records.title: Raise the export rate limit for the quarterly submission
records.text: Raises the per-partner export rate limit from 60 to 240 requests a minute for the quarterly submission window.

records.title: Patient records hang while a coordinator browses the cohort
records.text: A coordinator browsing the cohort by family name reports that the browser hangs; she has retried twice. Error rate is climbing and writes are queueing. Ingress shows three long-running GET /patients requests with a very large limit.

INC0011201.why: The change two hours before removed the page-size clamp on GET /patients that INC0010814's follow-up added; the ingress change is on another CI.

INC0011202.why: Thirty snapshots kept on the database's own volume fill it; the snapshot move is outside the two-day window and changes timing, not space.

INC0011203.why: The role change kept no privilege on audit_event, which the error names; the token rotation on the same CI that morning was done the way the runbook says.

INC0011204.why: Swapping old and new digests in one deployment leaves a holder with no working token, which the runbook warns against; the rate-limit change does not refuse with 401.

INC0011205.why: No change precedes it; the resolved incident describes the same unbounded GET /patients read and its fix.
